label: Date
guide_definition: The date of the recorded session or match
notes: Parsed from day/month/year.

label: Opposition code
guide_definition: A unique identifier for the opposing team
notes: Only filled in on match days.

label: Opposition
guide_definition: The full name of the opposing team
notes: Only filled in on match days. Read as Latin-1 so names such as København display correctly.

label: Days after match
guide_definition: A marker for the number of days after a match (e.g., MD+1 refers to one day post-match)
notes: 0 on match day. Capped at 10, so 10 means 10 or more days.

label: Days before match
guide_definition: A marker for the number of days before a match (e.g., MD-1 refers to one day before a match)
notes: 0 on match day. Capped at -10, so -10 means 10 or more days.

label: Season
guide_definition: The football season during which the data was recorded
notes: Written as 2022/2023.

label: Total distance
guide_definition: The total distance covered by a player during the session or match, measured in meters or kilometers
notes: Recorded in metres. Days without a session are stored as 0.

label: High-speed running (>21 km/h)
guide_definition: The distance covered at a speed above 21 km/h
notes: Lead load measure for the tool.

label: Very high-speed running (>24 km/h)
guide_definition: The distance covered at a speed above 24 km/h

label: Sprint distance (>27 km/h)
guide_definition: The distance covered at a speed above 27 km/h

label: Accelerations and decelerations (>2.5 m/s²)
guide_definition: The number of accelerations or decelerations above 2.5 m/s²
notes: Counts are fractional in this simulated data; round for display.

label: Accelerations and decelerations (>3.5 m/s²)
guide_definition: The number of accelerations or decelerations above 3.5 m/s²
notes: Counts are fractional in this simulated data; round for display.

label: Accelerations and decelerations (>4.5 m/s²)
guide_definition: The number of accelerations or decelerations above 4.5 m/s²
notes: Counts are fractional in this simulated data; round for display.

label: Session duration
guide_definition: The duration of the session in minutes

label: Peak speed
guide_definition: The highest speed recorded during the session
notes: Recorded in km/h. Modelled as recorded, without a log transform, for adaptive ranges.

label: Time in HR zone 1 (50–60% max HR)
guide_definition: The total time spent in heart rate zone 1 (50-60% Max HR)
notes: Supplied as hh:mm:ss; converted to minutes by the reader.

label: Time in HR zone 2 (60–70% max HR)
guide_definition: The total time spent in heart rate zone 2 (60-70% Max HR)
notes: Supplied as hh:mm:ss; converted to minutes by the reader.

label: Time in HR zone 3 (70–80% max HR)
guide_definition: The total time spent in heart rate zone 3 (70-80% Max HR)
notes: Supplied as hh:mm:ss; converted to minutes by the reader.

label: Time in HR zone 4 (80–90% max HR)
guide_definition: The total time spent in heart rate zone 4 (80-90% Max HR)
notes: Supplied as hh:mm:ss; converted to minutes by the reader.

label: Time in HR zone 5 (90–100% max HR)
guide_definition: The total time spent in heart rate zone 5 (90-100% Max HR)
notes: Supplied as hh:mm:ss; converted to minutes by the reader.

label: Distance per minute
notes: Derived: distance divided by session duration. Not in the data guide. Duration may include time outside the session, such as warm-ups, so values understate true intensity.

label: High-speed running (>21 km/h) per minute
notes: Derived: high-speed running (>21 km/h) divided by session duration. Not in the data guide. Duration may include time outside the session, such as warm-ups, so values understate true intensity.

label: Very high-speed running (>24 km/h) per minute
notes: Derived: very high-speed running (>24 km/h) divided by session duration. Not in the data guide. Duration may include time outside the session, such as warm-ups, so values understate true intensity.

label: Sprint distance (>27 km/h) per minute
